overview_description.description: Hawkeye, help farmers in the early detection of plant diseases using drone scanning service. Using in-house designed and manufactured drones, Hawkeye provides the Agricultural engineer with vegetation indices, thermal maps, and a bird-eye view for the farms to allow more accurate decision-making regarding resource usage and plant disease prevention. The solution also helps in determining the optimal needs of each crop segment from water, fertilizers & pesticides.
